name: Azerbaijan Soviet Socialist Republic (1937–1940)
description: A red field with a yellow hammer and sickle in the upper hoist above the initials 'AzSSR' in yellow Latin letters.
history: Flag laid down by the 1937 constitution of the Azerbaijan SSR, the first after the republic left the Transcaucasian federation, with the Latin initials 'AzSSR' under the hammer and sickle. The switch of the Azerbaijani alphabet to Cyrillic in 1940 changed the lettering.
